Detailed Description

A sub-class of a Schedule that represents a subroutine, function or
program unit.

:param symbol: the Symbol used to represent this Routine in its Container.
:type symbol: :py:class:`psyclone.psyir.symbols.RoutineSymbol`
:param Optional[bool] is_program: whether this Routine represents the
                                  entry point into a program (e.g.
                                  Fortran Program or C main()). Default is
                                  False.
:param kwargs: additional keyword arguments provided to the super class.
:type kwargs: unwrapped dict.

:raises TypeError: if any of the supplied arguments are of the wrong type.

76 def __init__(self, symbol, is_program=False, **kwargs):
77 if not isinstance(symbol, RoutineSymbol):
78 raise TypeError(f"Routine argument 'symbol' must be present and "
79 f"must be a RoutineSymbol but got "
80 f"'{type(symbol).__name__}'")
81 # These attributes need to be set before anything, as the _symbol
82 # is required for setting the parent links.
83 self._parent = None
84 self._symbol = symbol
85 super().__init__(**kwargs)
86
87 self._return_symbol = None
88 if not isinstance(is_program, bool):
89 raise TypeError(f"Routine argument 'is_program' must be a bool "
90 f"but got '{type(is_program).__name__}'")
91 self._is_program = is_program
92
93 # Add the symbol into the routine itself, unless the symbol table
94 # already contains a symbol with that name (e.g. a Function's return
95 # symbol).
96 if self._symbol.name not in self._symbol_table:
97 self.symbol_table.add(self._symbol)

Checks whether two nodes are equal. Two Routine nodes are equal
if they have the same name, same return symbol, same properties and
the inherited __eq__ is True.

:param object other: the object to check equality to.

99 def __eq__(self, other):
100 '''
101 Checks whether two nodes are equal. Two Routine nodes are equal
102 if they have the same name, same return symbol, same properties and
103 the inherited __eq__ is True.
104
105 :param object other: the object to check equality to.
106
107 :returns: whether other is equal to self.
108 :rtype: bool
109 '''
110 is_eq = super().__eq__(other)
111 is_eq = is_eq and self.name == other.name
112 is_eq = is_eq and self.is_program == other.is_program
113 is_eq = is_eq and self.return_symbol == other.return_symbol
114
115 return is_eq

◆ create()

psyclone.psyir.nodes.routine.Routine.create ( cls,
name,
symbol_table = None,
children = None,
is_program = False,
return_symbol_name = None ) 
Create an instance of the supplied class given a name, a symbol
table and a list of child nodes. This is implemented as a classmethod
so that it is able to act as a Factory for subclasses - e.g. it
will create a KernelSchedule if called from KernelSchedule.create().

:param str name: the name of the Routine (or subclass).
:param symbol_table: the symbol table associated with this Routine.
:type symbol_table: Optional[:py:class:`psyclone.psyGen.SymbolTable`]
:param children: a list of PSyIR nodes contained in the Routine.
:type children: Optional[list of :py:class:`psyclone.psyir.nodes.Node`]
:param Optional[bool] is_program: whether this Routine represents the
                                  entry point into a program (e.g.
                                  Fortran Program or C main()). Default
                                  is False.
:param str return_symbol_name: name of the symbol that holds the
    return value of this routine (if any). Must be present in the
    supplied symbol table.

:returns: an instance of `cls`.
:rtype: :py:class:`psyclone.psyir.nodes.Routine` or subclass

:raises TypeError: if the arguments to the create method
    are not of the expected type.

121 '''Create an instance of the supplied class given a name, a symbol
122 table and a list of child nodes. This is implemented as a classmethod
123 so that it is able to act as a Factory for subclasses - e.g. it
124 will create a KernelSchedule if called from KernelSchedule.create().
125
126 :param str name: the name of the Routine (or subclass).
127 :param symbol_table: the symbol table associated with this Routine.
128 :type symbol_table: Optional[:py:class:`psyclone.psyGen.SymbolTable`]
129 :param children: a list of PSyIR nodes contained in the Routine.
130 :type children: Optional[list of :py:class:`psyclone.psyir.nodes.Node`]
131 :param Optional[bool] is_program: whether this Routine represents the
132 entry point into a program (e.g.
133 Fortran Program or C main()). Default
134 is False.
135 :param str return_symbol_name: name of the symbol that holds the
136 return value of this routine (if any). Must be present in the
137 supplied symbol table.
138
139 :returns: an instance of `cls`.
140 :rtype: :py:class:`psyclone.psyir.nodes.Routine` or subclass
141
142 :raises TypeError: if the arguments to the create method
143 are not of the expected type.
144
145 '''
146 if not isinstance(name, str):
147 raise TypeError(
148 f"name argument in create method of Routine class "
149 f"should be a string but found '{type(name).__name__}'.")
150 if symbol_table and not isinstance(symbol_table, SymbolTable):
151 raise TypeError(
152 f"symbol_table argument in create method of Routine class "
153 f"should be a SymbolTable but found "
154 f"'{type(symbol_table).__name__}'.")
155 if not children:
156 children = []
157 if not isinstance(children, list):
158 raise TypeError(
159 f"children argument in create method of Routine class "
160 f"should be a list but found '{type(children).__name__}'.")
161 for child in children:
162 if not isinstance(child, Node):
163 raise TypeError(
164 f"child of children argument in create method of "
165 f"Routine class should be a PSyIR Node but "
166 f"found '{type(child).__name__}'.")
167
168 symbol = RoutineSymbol(name)
169 routine = cls(symbol, is_program=is_program, symbol_table=symbol_table)
170 routine.children = children
171 if return_symbol_name:
172 routine.return_symbol = routine.symbol_table.lookup(
173 return_symbol_name, scope_limit=routine)
174 return routine

414 def replace_with(self, node, keep_name_in_context=True):
415 '''Removes self and its descendents from the PSyIR tree to which it
416 is connected and replaces it with the supplied node (and its
417 descendents).
418
419 The node must be a Routine (or subclass) and has the same Symbol as
420 self.
421
422 keep_name_in_context is ignored for this replace_with implementation,
423 however we keep the argument to match with the base implementation.
424
425 :param node: the node that will replace self in the PSyIR tree.
426 :type node: :py:class:`psyclone.psyir.nodes.Routine`
427 :param bool keep_name_in_context: ignored.
428
429 :raises TypeError: if the argument node is not a Routine.
430 :raises GenerationError: if this node does not have a parent.
431 :raises GenerationError: if the argument 'node' has a parent
432 :raises GenerationError: if self and node do not have the same Symbol.
433 '''
434 if not isinstance(node, Routine):
435 raise TypeError(
436 f"The argument node in method replace_with in the Routine "
437 f"class should be a Routine but found '{type(node).__name__}'."
438 )

440 raise GenerationError(

446 f"Routine class should be None but found "
447 f"'{type(node.parent).__name__}'.")
448 if self._symbol != node._symbol:
449 raise GenerationError(
450 "The symbol of argument node in method replace_with in the "
451 "Routine class should be the same as the Routine being "
452 "replaced.")
453 super().replace_with(node, keep_name_in_context=keep_name_in_context)

187 def update_parent_symbol_table(self, new_parent):
188 ''' Update the Routine's new parent's symbol tables with the
189 corresponding RoutineSymbol.
190
191 :param new_parent: The new parent of this node.
192 :type new_parent: :py:class:`psyclone.psyir.nodes.ScopingNode`
193
194 :raises GenerationError: if a symbol with the same name already exists
195 in the scope.
196 :raises GenerationError: if a Routine with the same name already
197 exists in the scope.
198 :raises GenerationError: if a Codeblock representing a routine with
199 the same name already exists in the scope.
200 '''
201 if self._parent is not None:
202 try:
203 # TODO 2702: Need to check that this Routine's symbol is in
204 # the current _parent symbol table, as otherwise this breaks
205 # during copying.
206 if (self._parent.symbol_table.lookup(self.name)
207 is self._symbol):
208 self._parent.symbol_table.remove(self._symbol)
209 except ValueError:
210 pass
211 except KeyError:
212 pass
213 elif new_parent is not None:
214 # If the current parent is None and the new parent is not None
215 # then we remove the RoutineSymbol from the Routine's symbol table
216 # if it is present.
217 try:
218 if self.symbol_table.lookup(self.name) is self._symbol:
219 self.symbol_table.remove(self._symbol)
220 except KeyError:
221 pass
222 if new_parent is not None:
223 # If we weren't able to remove this symbol from a previous symbol
224 # table then we may need to create a new symbol for this Routine.
225
226 # The symbol may also be in scope, if it is then we check
227 # whether the scope already has a Routine or CodeBlock
228 # with this name and error if so.
229 try:
230 sym = new_parent.symbol_table.lookup(self.name)
231 # If the found symbol is not the symbol used to initialise
232 # this Routine then we raise an error, as we won't be able
233 # to add it to the parent.
234 if sym is not self._symbol:
235 raise GenerationError(
236 f"Can't add routine '{self.name}' into a "
237 f"scope that already contains a symbol with "
238 f"the same name.")
239 # Check that the scope doens't contain a Routine or
240 # CodeBlock representing a Routine with this name.
241 routines = new_parent.walk(Routine)
242 for routine in routines:
243 # Ignore itself.
244 if routine is self:
245 continue
246 if routine.name == self.name:
247 raise GenerationError(
248 f"Can't add routine '{self.name}' into a "
249 f"scope that already contains a Routine "
250 f"with that name.")
251 codeblocks = new_parent.walk(CodeBlock)
252 for codeblock in codeblocks:
253 routines = walk(codeblock.get_ast_nodes,
254 (Fortran2003.Subroutine_Subprogram,
255 Fortran2003.Function_Subprogram))
256 for routine in routines:
257 name = str(routine.children[0].children[1])
258 if name == self.name:
259 raise GenerationError(
260 f"Can't add routine '{self.name}' into"
261 f" a scope that already contains a "
262 f"CodeBlock representing a routine "
263 f"with that name.")
264 except KeyError:
265 sym = self._symbol
266 # If lookup found this Routine's symbol then we are performing
267 # replace_with, which is handled here.
268 if sym is self._symbol:
269 try:
270 new_parent.symbol_table.lookup(self._symbol.name)
271 except KeyError:
272 new_parent.symbol_table.add(self._symbol)
273 elif self.symbol_table:
274 # Otherwise if new_parent is None, then we place the symbol
275 # into this Routine's symbol table if possible. Not all Routine
276 # subclasses have a symbol table, hence the elif statement.
277 try:
278 self.symbol_table.lookup(self._symbol.name)
279 except KeyError:
280 self.symbol_table.add(self._symbol)
281
